test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) SV – XQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13a2d2932f246f574ed46670b6e747f289a89514e2a601d24b7c49a0f8be4ff5.png] 

Option 2) JM – OH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5327413210799b1af501d32c889031a96876e72770df0d5fdeb7948866da8eed.png] 

Option 3) BE – GZ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1c9ca89086f9c1905d7e63860bf989b14890791ce1da578d0d4649d9071225c.png] 

Option 4) OR – TN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b2f723aa8094a5da6e2b3c41d4f5d79c73623d4bebbad1d2ed11930871132a3.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'OR – TN' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
